name: menu-to-gameplay
demonstrates: PLAY enters .gameplay and shows the streamed isometric city: ground lattice, whole-building sprites, and the player actor, with no placeholder text over it. Rooftop signs are NOT promised in frame: RooftopSignPlacement signs roughly one in three BUILDING blocks, and the lattice leaves ~1-in-4 blocks deliberately empty (an empty block is never signed, per the placements.isEmpty guard), so signed roofs are nearer 1-in-4 of all blocks and whether one lands in frame is a property of the fixed GameScene.worldSeed and camera position rather than something this journey guarantees. Gate is human/vision review of the gameplay-city screenshot; the only machine-checked steps are assert_running, and placeholder-label removal is pinned by ScreensTests.test_gameplayScreenNode_mountsNoComingSoonText and ScreensTests.test_gameplayScreenNode_mountsOnlyTheContainerMarker_andNoTextAnywhere, not by this journey. The navigate step below is vision-located and therefore does NOT replace the element-driven PLAY tap that AccessibleSKView exists to protect: that stays owned by CyberpunkMonsterCrawlUITests.test_launchesIntoMenu_withAHittablePlayButton_thatStartsARun, because a finger tap can pass while an element-driven tap (XCUITest / runtime probe / VoiceOver) misses PLAY entirely. This journey is additional coverage, not a substitute.

steps.target: the large neon-outlined PLAY button in the middle of the title screen that starts a new run (NOT the plain HIGH SCORES button below it)
